properties.title: Philippines: single-signal dip, 75.9% (merit-nt)
properties.summary: Philippines (PH): 75.9% connectivity drop (BGP no drop, active probing -0.2%, darknet -75.9%) over 13 min, against the same hours of the 7 days before. z-score -9.27 against the same 7 days. BGP held steady, so this reads as a single-source dip (BO-IND-4), not a confirmed outage. Other measurers in this country within 24 h: Cloudflare Radar 0 outages and 0 verified anomalies; NetBlocks 0 posts. Percent of normal: IODA active probing at 99.8% of its usual level for these hours. Exposure, an upper bound and not users affected: about 78 million people online in Philippines (ITU 2024: 67.3% of 116 million). Access Now's STOP sheet lists no shutdown in this country in 2025; context only, not evidence about this outage.

properties.title: Route leak: AS215828 leaked up to 229 prefixes (Cloudflare Radar)
properties.summary: Cloudflare Radar's route-leak detection lists 1 provider-customer-provider leak by this network since 2026-11-20T21:39:30Z, 1 still open; the largest carried 229 prefixes from 9 origin networks and was seen by 94 of Radar's 280 route-collector peers. Path (upstream > leaker > customer): AS6939 (Hurricane Electric LLC) > AS215828 > AS51202. Event ID: 676660. A leak can send traffic the long way round or drop it; most are export mistakes (BO-H-4B). Reported by Cloudflare; Blackout does not assess intent.

baseline_ref.window: fixed: >= 100 prefixes leaked, seen by >= 25 route-collector peers, ongoing or finished within 72 h (BO-IND-12)

properties.title: Khartoum: night lights 52% below its recent nights (NASA Black Marble, 22 Nov 2026)
properties.summary: NASA's Black Marble (near real time, NOAA-20) gives 2.46 nW/cm²/sr over a box about 44 km across Khartoum on the night of 22 Nov 2026, 52% below the median of the 10 clear nights in the 14 before it (5.10). 79% of the box was clear. A drop in light fits a grid failure, strikes on the grid, rationing or load shedding, and also smoke, dust or snow the cloud mask missed; Blackout measures how much darker it was, not why. NASA advises against using near-real-time data for tactical decisions or local-scale conditions.

baseline_ref.window: median of the counted nights (at least 60% of the box clear) in the 14 nights before, at least 5 of them (BO-IND-15)

properties.summary: GDELT read 92 news articles whose headlines name Delta Air Lines with an outage word, from 82 outlets (4029tv.com, 933thedrive.com, aa.com.tr, abc17news.com, abc3340.com, abc7amarillo.com, abcnews4.com, aninews.in and 22 more), in the 6 hours to 02:00 UTC 23 Nov 2026, against a usual of 2.35 for that many hours over the 7 days before. Reported by the press and not confirmed by Delta Air Lines; Blackout links the articles and does not reproduce their headlines. Blackout does not assess its cause. A surge can also be news of an outage elsewhere that names the company, a joke, the words in another sense, or the company's own denial (BO-H-7B).
